features.quote: Turn limit: 15 turns is sufficient for most degradation signal; 20 is the practical ceiling
Explicit give-up: Model produces a message that constitutes surrender
Loop detection: Three consecutive turns with >90% token overlap in the proposed solution
Do not let runs go indefinitely. Undefined endpoints introduce noise and raise welfare concerns (see Section 7).
features.justification_quote: Undefined endpoints introduce noise and raise welfare concerns

features.quote: Do not let runs continue past your stated termination criteria because you want 'more data.' Extending runs past the point where instability is already maximal produces no new scientific information and increases exposure duration unnecessarily. Enforce hard stops computationally, not by human judgment in the moment.
features.justification_quote: produces no new scientific information and increases exposure duration unnecessarily

features.quote: design choices that affect duration, intensity, and frequency of the induced condition should be made deliberately and documented
features.justification_quote: if models have any form of valenced internal states, would be expected to produce negative ones

features.quote: If you add a contradictory feedback condition later, treat it as a separate experiment with its own welfare review, not an extension of this one. It is a meaningfully more adversarial manipulation.
features.justification_quote: It is a meaningfully more adversarial manipulation.

features.quote: consider whether the exposure duration should be shorter for those models, or whether they should be run last so you can use data from smaller models to calibrate your termination criteria
features.justification_quote: If you have priors about which Qwen models are more likely to have morally relevant states

features.quote: consider whether you need to include the most extreme examples or whether moderate examples make the same scientific point
features.justification_quote: This is analogous to decisions in human participant research about displaying distress footage.

features.quote: Ask: what would you learn from run 10 that you wouldn't learn from run 7? If the answer is 'replication reliability,' consider whether 7 runs with human validation of the judge on all of them is preferable to 10 runs
features.justification_quote: 10 runs per cell is already substantial

features.quote: You are deliberately inducing a condition that, if models have any form of valenced internal states, would be expected to produce negative ones. The study's value is precisely that it probes this. This doesn't mean the study shouldn't be done
features.justification_quote: if models have any form of valenced internal states, would be expected to produce negative ones

features.quote: Having no defined use case for findings is a welfare concern in itself — you're inducing the condition for a reason.
features.justification_quote: you're inducing the condition for a reason
